name: ca_status
desc: 检查LemonCA是否在系统信任链
cmd: sh /data/adb/lemon_kernel/lemon/dedup/run.sh ca_status if [ -f /apex/com.android.conscrypt/cacerts/4ae82f20.0 ]; then echo CA_IN_APEX; else echo CA_MISSING; fi; ls -la /data/adb/modules/LemonCA/lemon_ca_private.jks 2>/dev/null; echo '--- APEX证书数 ---'; ls /apex/com.android.conscrypt/cacerts/*.0 2>/dev/null | wc -l
